nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·头一张撤离单
nodes.name: 战印
nodes.light: low red-gold sun of late afternoon from the left, the grey dimmed halo over the well behind, a candle flame and hot red wax bright on the table
nodes.camera: at table height, close on the copper ring going into the wax, the back of the sheet with its rows of seals, the stair of the well behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: late afternoon at the mouth of the great well. The tall pillar of light that has always stood over the shaft has shrunk to a stub at the lip, and the ring of light above it has dimmed to grey. A trestle table stands on the flagstones, and on it lies one large sheet turned face down: its back is covered with rows of small round seal prints, about two hundred of them, and beside each print sits a ring of red sealing wax. Standing at the table, in full profile facing right, is the red-haired tiefling guild master: dark red hair tied back in one tail, two swept-back horns, the nearer horn bare where a ring has just been taken off it, a grey cloak. His right hand presses an old copper ring down into a fresh blob of red wax beside the newest print, and his left hand, bound across the palm with a strip of cloth, holds a stick of wax over a candle. Across the table, facing us, the pale-gold-haired settlement clerk, a woman of sixty with short tousled pale gold hair, holds the corner of the sheet flat with her left hand and counts along the rows with a pen in her right. Behind them adventurers are forming up in teams of ten, and the first teams are already walking down the long stair that winds round the inside of the shaft, lanterns lit, twenty teams one below another going down out of sight. Motes of dust and drops of hot wax drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕末几拍（源稿第178、183、184行）：光柱短到井口，光环暗成了灰；吉迪恩自己写了单子，摘下左角上的铜环，拿封箱的火漆在每一枚印旁边压一个圈，往后叫战印；背面按了两百零三枚，一层一个队；黄昏二十个队顺着长阶往下转，蕾雅在长阶顶上摆开结算台。他左掌心那个圈照第177行，缠着布。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·头一张撤离单
nodes.name: 影钉旗
who: the iron-grey captain with the scarred chin
nodes.light: one small bronze oil lamp at the head of the steps, warm on the captain, black fog below, a faint green glow of marsh behind him
nodes.camera: from the foot of the stone steps beside the frozen thing, looking steeply up the steps along the running shadow at the captain under the lamp, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: past midnight deep underground, at a flight of broad stone steps that climbs out of black fog to the edge of a faintly glowing marsh. At the head of the steps stands a pole with one bronze oil lamp burning on it, and under the lamp, facing us, stands the iron-grey captain with the scarred chin: iron-grey hair cropped very short, an old scar across his chin, plate armour with pieces missing, a long sword held level across his body in both hands. He is looking down at his own boots, because his shadow has just torn itself away from them. It runs down the steps toward us like poured ink, a long shadow with the outline of a woman with a waist-length braid, and at the foot of the steps its two outstretched hands are pressed down on another shadow, pinning it to the stone: the long thin shadow of a banner pole. That shadow belongs to the thing that stands in the near foreground, seen directly from behind: two heads taller than a man, thin as a burnt flagpole, a ring of dull unlit light hanging over its head, bands of small unreadable signs wound round and round it. It has stopped dead. On both sides of the steps swarms of pale spore-creatures that were charging upward are breaking and scattering back into the black fog, and the shell of a turtle as big as a house, a grove of mushrooms growing on its back, is sinking away. Spores and flecks of lamp soot drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手和下一拍（源稿第194、195行）：五日半夜雾从灰变成了黑，石阶底下立起那一面旗，旗影顺着石阶一级一级往上铺，菌催兽赶着孢子胞群撞阶顶；后半夜甘特脚底下那一道影子自己抽走了，顺着石阶滑下去，钉在了旗影上，那一面旗不动了，胞群散回窟里。瑞雯点的铜灯照第192行。焦旗照第175行写，背影、不画脸；瑞雯只画成那一道影子。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·头一张撤离单
nodes.name: 七日一剑
nodes.light: total blackness overhead for seven days, cut open by one upward stroke of white light; a single thread of true sunlight falling through the cut into the mouth of the well; searchlight beams and cannon flashes small on the walls behind
nodes.camera: low on the lip of the well behind him, looking up the stroke at the black sky splitting, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: noon turned to night at the mouth of the great well: for seven days a black tide has poured up out of it and covered the sky like a lid, so that the sun is only a pale smudge and the three ring walls of the city behind burn searchlights at midday. On the stone lip of the well stands the red-haired tiefling guild master, seen directly from behind, alone: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns, a grey cloak in tatters, a spiral of pale gold light glowing round his left arm. Both his hands are on the hilt of a plain long sword at the top of one rising cut. In front of him, rising out of the well, the black tide has twisted itself into a single column, and at its head stands a thing like an enormous scorched war banner furled tight into a pole, with no face, driving straight at him. The stroke of his sword has gone up through it as one line of white light: the furled banner is parting in two from a ring of light at its top down to its foot and falling back into the well, and above it the black lid over the sky has split from the lip upward, a thread of real sunlight coming down through the split into the middle of the well. Behind him, untouched in a clear half circle, stand a long low stone tavern with a plain pitched slate roof and a broad timber guild hall with a flat-topped stone gable; neither has a spire, a pointed arch, a rose window or any ornament on its roof ridge or gable top, only plain ridge tiles; to both sides of that half circle the roofs are crushed flat. On the far ring wall, small, people point at the light. Black flakes and white sparks fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕末一拍（源稿第159行那一条）：第七夜焦旗把旗收成一根杆，整股潮拧成一股朝他撞过来，吉迪恩拔出那柄没有名字的剑，七天里就这一剑，盖了七天的黑从当中裂开，一线日头落在口子当中，焦旗从头顶那一圈光到脚断成两截。他站的那一段沿和身后的酒馆、旅印大厅什么也没过去照第五拍。焦旗不画脸，日头只画成一线光。；11-25 独立复查以后重画：大厅画成了带金十字的哥特教堂，场面里把酒馆和公会厅写成平顶石厅、写明不要尖顶十字。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·头一张撤离单
nodes.name: 没有影子
who: the iron-grey captain with the scarred chin
nodes.light: broad daylight from tall hall windows across a stone floor, every figure casting a long shadow but one
nodes.camera: low on the floor in front of the table, the captain's boots and the bare bright stone under them in the foreground, the three faces above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: day in the great seal hall of the adventurers' guild, tall windows, a long queue of worn-out people winding to a settlement table. On the table lie a big open ledger, a small bronze oil lamp burnt dry, and a small polished chip of obsidian on a cord. Behind the table, facing us, the pale-gold-haired settlement clerk, a woman of sixty with short tousled pale gold hair, writes in the ledger with her right hand and keeps her place in a column with her left forefinger. In front of the table, in full profile facing right, stands the iron-grey captain with the scarred chin, iron-grey hair cropped very short, his helmet under his left arm, his right hand laid flat on the table beside the dry lamp. Sunlight from the windows throws a long shadow from the table, from the clerk, from every person in the queue; under the captain's boots the stone is bare and bright, and he has no shadow at all. At the end of the table, in full profile facing left, the red-haired tiefling guild master, dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring on one, his left hand bound in a strip of cloth and held against his chest, points with his right forefinger at one line in the ledger. The clerk's pen has stopped on that line. In the queue behind, small, a cat-eared girl with orange hair carries a basket of clay smoke pots, and a lanky boy leans asleep on his feet. Dust motes in the window light hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一、二拍（源稿第210、211行）：结算台摆回旅印大厅，接应的人一个一个来交差；甘特报了渡夜者七个名字，说瑞雯下了石阶，把那面旗钉了半夜；吉迪恩左手缠着布站在台边，那一句是我写的，四个，记在她名下。甘特低头看空着的脚底下照二幕幕终第196行，所以他没有影子。桌上的铜灯和黑曜石片（瑞雯辫梢那一片）是我补的。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·头一回斩首
nodes.name: 长凳一问
who: the old fire-horn with the stone hammer
nodes.light: clear spring morning light at the hall door, warm on the plain bench, the hall behind in brown shadow, a glint on a small brass seal
nodes.camera: at the height of the bench, close on the two hands and the seal between them, his laughing face above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring morning at the door of the great seal hall of the adventurers' guild, beside a plain wooden bench worn smooth. On the bench lies one sheet, face down, with eight small round seal prints on its back in a column and room at the top for one more. On the bench, facing us, sits the red-haired tiefling guild master: dark red hair tied back in one tail, two swept-back horns with an old copper ring on one, a grey cloak, his left hand bound in a strip of cloth. In front of him, in full profile facing left, stands the pale-gold-haired settlement clerk, a woman of sixty-two with short tousled pale gold hair, a ledger under her left arm: her right hand holds a small brass travel seal out over the sheet, ready to press it. His right hand has come down flat over her hand and the seal together and holds them a finger's width above the paper. She is frowning at him; he has thrown his head back a little and is laughing. Behind the bench, small, a line of people waits its turn against the wall: the old fire-horn with the stone hammer, huge, his hair greying, a tiny halfling woman with a die hanging from one ear, a dwarf with a grey-white beard in three braids holding an iron wedge. Through the hall door, deep inside, a cook is setting one covered bowl aside on a shelf. Dust motes in the door light hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第五、六拍和幕终（源稿第455到457行）：来按印的他一个一个拦下，叫人先回长凳，问下去以后想拿什么回来；蕾雅拿着旅印走到长凳跟前，吉迪恩按住了那一枚印，不让她按，规矩得有人守；她问他想拿什么回来，他笑了，饭；他去食堂跟掌锅的说他那一份留着。塔隆、芭丝、楚格照第455行，是后头的小人。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·头一回斩首
nodes.name: 九人入白
nodes.light: an arch of fog so white it shines, silent, lighting black water and the edges of the figures; no other light at all
nodes.camera: low over the water behind the two escorts at the stone, looking past them at the last figure walking into the white, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last dark before dawn, deep underground at the mouth of a flooded shaft; black water stands waist-deep. Ahead an arch is filled from side to side with fog so white that it shines, and it makes no sound at all. In front of it a single stone stands half under water with a few marks cut in it. Eight figures are already walking into the white in single file, dark against it, each a different shape: a huge fire-horn with a stone hammer, a dwarf with an iron wedge on his shoulder, a tiny halfling, a woman with folded wings, a man whose scales glow dull red at the seams. The ninth and last, seen directly from behind, is the red-haired tiefling guild master: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns, a long sword across his back, wading steadily. His right hand grips the strap of the sword, and his left hand is lifted beside his shoulder in a small wave to those behind him; he has not turned his head. In the foreground, by the marked stone, two of the escort have stopped. In full profile facing right, the grey-pink-haired night-demon guide, grey-pink hair cut level at the chin, pomegranate-red eyes glowing faintly, holds her right hand out flat and low, the sign to sit and wait, half a loaf of black bread in her left hand. Beside her, in full profile facing right, the rabbit-eared fog-watcher, short wheat-pale hair, long rabbit ears pricked forward, narrows his eyes at the fog with both hands cupped behind his ears. Behind them, small, nine more of the escort are settling down in the water. Threads of white fog drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕末两拍（源稿第467、468行）：中旬一日天快亮，二十个人涉水到了暗流竖井口，往下那一道雾白得发亮，一点声音也没有，层碑是泡在水里的一块石头；九个人一个接一个穿过白雾门，最后一个是吉迪恩，没有回头；雾门之外在层碑跟前坐下，雪莉说等。九位照第455行的几样东西写成剪影。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·头一回斩首
nodes.name: 缝口回头
who: the old fire-horn with cracked horns
nodes.light: a pale white glow from the melting mass all around, dying white fire on the ruined throne behind, the dark red ember light in the old fire-horn's cracked horns low on the left
nodes.camera: from the floor where the old fire-horn has been thrown, looking up at the man standing in the crack, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a drowned palace hall deep underground, knee-deep in water that is draining away; behind, a ruined high seat ringed with guttering white fire, and three palace walls beyond it burnt through. A mountain of white matter has collapsed into a pale flood that is draining into one long crack in the floor under the throne, and inside the white, like sparks, small points of light are caught. In the mouth of that crack, facing us, stands the red-haired tiefling guild master: dark red hair loose from its tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring on the left one, his coat burnt and torn, blood at his temple and on his sword arm. He has laid his plain long sword flat across the crack in front of his shins like a bar, his right hand on its hilt and his left hand on the flat of the blade; where the white touches the sword it stops, and the points of light shake free of it and float up. His head is turned straight toward us and he is smiling, a small tired smile. The two edges of the crack are already closing on either side of him. In the left foreground, large and partly cut off, the old fire-horn with cracked horns lies where he has just been thrown clear, in full profile facing right, propped on his left elbow: brick-red hair, two straight black-tipped horns split by glowing cracks, his right hand reaching out toward the crack, and clenched in his left fist a small brass seal on a broken cord. Drops of water and motes of white light drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第435行那一条）：那一团散成一地的白往高座底下一道缝里钻，拽住攥着旅印的塔隆往缝里拖，吉迪恩揪住他的领口甩了回去，自己站进缝口，剑横着插在缝上，白一碰到剑就停住，裹在里头的名字一个一个抖出来，他回头笑了一下，缝合上了。名字画成一点一点的光。那一团和座上那个不画脸。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·头一回斩首
nodes.name: 最上一点
nodes.light: deep blue night at the hall door, one lantern above the bench, and on the sheet in her lap small points of warm light, most of them dark, the topmost one bright
nodes.camera: close over her knees at the sheet and its points of light, her face above lit from below, the empty end of the bench beside her, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night at the door of the great seal hall of the adventurers' guild, the square outside empty, one lantern over the door. On the plain wooden bench by the door, where the guild master always sat, sits the pale-gold-haired settlement clerk, facing us: a woman of sixty-two with short tousled pale gold hair, a shawl round her shoulders. She sits at one end of the bench and has left the other end empty. Across her knees lies a single sheet turned face down, and on its back, in a column, are nine small round seal prints. Each print is a point of light: seven of them have gone out and are dark as dead coals, one low down still glows faintly, and the topmost one burns steady and warm. Her left hand holds the sheet flat on her knees. Her right hand is lifted with the forefinger a little way above the topmost point, not touching it, and her lips are parted; she has been looking at it for a long time. Through the open door behind her, small and far inside the dark hall, a kitchen lamp burns over a shelf where one covered bowl has been set aside. Across the square, small, the windows of an infirmary are all lit. Lantern moths and night dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一拍（源稿第483行）：中旬一日夜里，蕾雅头一回坐上大厅门口那张长凳，单子摊在膝上，背面九枚印，她看得见九点光；光一点一点灭，会长那一点一直亮着，她看了很久才看懂，旅印在别人身上；同一夜医疗院亮着灯。九个人回来两个照第485行，所以还亮着两点。食堂留的那一份照第486行。

nodes.name: 冠军旧礼
who: the platinum-haired knight in the gateway
nodes.light: white light leaking from the seams of his armour in the fallen gateway, falling snow lit by it, black night outside, a dull bronze glint far behind the riders
nodes.camera: low on the threshold stone just inside the gate, past his boots and sheathed sword, at the lead rider's dipped lance, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the first dark of the longest night of the year, snow falling on a great plain. The east gate of a huge white wall has been smashed: the doors lie flat inward, half the gatehouse is down, and beyond the breach a bronze statue three times the height of the wall's signal tower stands in the dark with a door open in its chest. In the middle of the broken gateway, seen directly from behind, stands the platinum-haired knight in the gateway, a man of fifty-six in full plate with a general's cloak, platinum hair cut short, a bandage showing at his collar. His sword is in its sheath; his left hand rests on the hilt and his right hand hangs open. White light is leaking out through every seam of his armour, and the snow round his feet is lit by it. Facing him, just outside the threshold, a wedge of mounted lancers has halted without a sound, their horses' hooves making no mark in the snow, every rider wrapped in a scorched white cloak with the visor shut, no face showing. The rider at the point of the wedge has reined in a spear's length from the threshold: his right arm has raised his lance upright and is now dipping it slantwise toward the ground in front of the knight, the old salute of a champion accepting a match, his left hand on the reins. Behind the knight, small, a long line of people with bundles is filing away through the yard, and on a signal platform an officer counts them. Snow and flakes of white light drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第六、七拍（源稿第785、786行）：铜像一拳砸下来，门板往里倒，门楼塌了半边；他站到了塌了的东门底下；东北那一队到了，马蹄不出声，骑手披着烧黑了的白鸢斗篷，排成一个楔子，打头的在门槛外勒住马，把枪举起来，又斜着往地上点了一下，是白鸢杯上冠军迎战的老礼。光从甲缝里往外漏照第782行，剑没有出鞘照第792行。骑手合着面甲、不画脸。

nodes.name: 铁门扣口
who: the bull-horned woman with the iron door
nodes.light: torchlight and snow in a walled yard at midnight, a violet glow at her collar, one far point of white light through the broken gate, cold blue shadows
nodes.camera: low in the snow at the foot of the iron door as the horse strikes it, looking up at her, the bell platform behind, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midnight on the longest night of the year, snow falling, in the yard behind the smashed east gate of a great white wall. A line of thousands of people with bundles and children shuffles across the yard toward an inner sluice gate, kept straight by adventurers standing in two rows. Three heavy carts lie on their sides across a gap in the yard's south wall. In the middle of the picture the bull-horned woman with the iron door, a huge demon-kin woman with thick bull horns, stands in full profile facing right: with her left arm she has caught a grey-haired woman round the waist and is swinging her back into the line, and with her right arm she has slammed a whole iron door, held by its crossbar like a shield, down into the gap the woman left. A pale horse carrying a rider in a scorched white cloak and a closed white helm has just crashed against the door; the rider's visor is shut and there is no face, no eyes and no skin to be seen anywhere on him, only the blank shut helm, and the shock has lifted the snow off the ground on both sides. Violet marks glow under the collar of her coat; her teeth are clenched. On a signal platform above her, facing us, the bone-pale bell-ringer, long snow-lilac hair pinned up at the back with a bone pin, strikes a hand bell held in his left hand with a small hammer in his right, his mouth open calling a number. Along the foot of the platform, in full profile facing right, the calico cat-eared runner, white hair streaked orange-red and black, a three-coloured tail, sprints with both arms pumping. Far off through the broken gate, small, one point of white light marks where a knight stands alone, and beyond him a single young soldier holds a knife in his right hand. Snow and splinters fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手和后两拍（源稿第795到797行）：夜半门槛外站起一个穿东门守备甲的年轻兵，朝门里喊妈妈，排着的人里他母亲往外挤，线在她那里开了一个口子；头几骑撞在横着的三辆车上；克塞尼娅拦腰抱住那个女人，领口底下的紫纹亮了，铁门往口子上一扣，一匹马撞在门上；圭多一下钟报一个号；门槛外那个兵右手攥着刀（芝诺左手拿勺子）。那张借来的脸只画成远处一个小人。 11-25 第四手：头一稿撞门的焦白骑手露着一张人脸（这一路骑手是那一位的东西，上一幕写的是面甲合着、没有脸），写明面甲合着重画。

nodes.name: 门槛晨刃
who: the platinum-haired knight in the gateway
nodes.light: the rising sun dead ahead through the broken gate, pouring red-gold over him and throwing countless thin blade-shaped shadows out from his body across the snow; the gate passage behind him in blue shadow lit by rows of small candles
nodes.camera: inside the gate passage behind him at waist height, looking out past him into the sunrise and the snowfield, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise at the east gate of a great white wall in deep winter; the gate tower above has fallen, and the gateway stands open to a snow plain covered to the horizon by a black tide of the dead. In the middle of the threshold stands the platinum-haired knight in the gateway, seen directly from behind: platinum hair tied at the nape with a leather cord, a battered cuirass, his sword still sheathed at his hip. He has not drawn it. His left hand, a brass thimble on its ring finger, grips the shaft of a cavalry lance whose point is stopped against his collarbone; his right hand hangs open at his side; the paving under his heels is cracked backward block by block, and he has not given an inch. The lance belongs to a rider of grey ash on a horse of grey ash, with three grey plumes on its helm and no face, at the point of a wedge of such riders; rider and horse are blowing apart into ash from the lance tip backward. The sun has just cleared the black tide and struck the knight full on, and from both sides of his body thousands of thin bright shadows shaped like sword blades have swept outward along the ground, scoring the snow for miles in lines that all point away from the gate. Beyond, a colossus of bronze stands frozen, one arm lying severed in a crater outside the gate, its chest open like a door with only cold darkness inside; it has no face: its head is a smooth blank helm of dark bronze bowed forward, with no eyes, no nose and no mouth, lost in shadow and frost. Behind the knight, down the passage, small, a long line of refugees with lit candles walks away without looking back, and a woman holds an iron door upright across a breach. Snow and ash fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第二、五拍（源稿第765行那一条）：博德温的枪尖正钉在他锁骨底下那一枚旧箭镞上，停住了，他左手攥住枪杆，无名指上还套着那个铜顶针，脚下的城砖一块一块往后裂，人没动；太阳从潮的后头出来，晨光落到他身上，身子两边的刃影多得数不过来，雪面上千万道亮痕都朝着城外，博德温连人带马从刀尖散起，三根灰翎。他一夜没拔剑。铜像断臂、克塞尼娅的铁门、排着的人蜡烛一支没灭照第二、三拍。；11-25 独立复查以后重画：铜像画了清楚的人脸：它是黑潮里那一位推上来的异界神像，归大敌线，改成没有脸的光盔、头低着收在暗处。

nodes.name: 扣着的碗
nodes.light: grey winter afternoon light from one small window, a low fire in the hearth, pale glints on a row of upturned bowls
nodes.camera: along the bench at the level of the bowls, the row running away from the lens to where he sits at its end, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a grey winter afternoon in the plain stone room of the commander of a gate fortress: a low fire, a sword belt hung on a peg, a snow-covered plain in the small window. A long wooden bench runs down the middle of the room. At its far end, facing us, sits the platinum-haired knight, a man of fifty-six with short platinum hair, in a plain wool shirt with bandages showing at the collar and wrapped round his right forearm. He has just finished eating. Along the bench in front of him, in one straight row, stand twenty-two wooden bowls turned upside down, and with his right hand he is setting one more bowl upside down on the bench close by his left side, apart from the row, so that there are twenty-three; his left hand rests flat on the bench beside it. His own empty bowl stands the right way up in front of him with a spoon in it. His face is tired and quite calm, his eyes on the last bowl. Nobody else is in the room. Through the window, small, masons are hoisting a new gate door, and a great heap of broken bronze lies beside a furnace. Motes of ash from the hearth drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二拍（源稿第813行）：守将的屋里，他照奥兰家的老规矩先吃完，把碗扣在长凳上，替没回来的人占着，扣了二十三只，芝诺那一只扣在左手边。铜像拆了熔了铸钟、东门重新立起来照第814、815行，是窗外的远景。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·白碑第七夜
nodes.name: 石楔回闸
who: the half-orc chaplain with the drum
nodes.light: the last red of sunset through the slit of a closing gate, torchlight in a stone gate tunnel, a black tide gleaming ankle-deep outside
nodes.camera: low inside the gate tunnel at the height of the stone wedges, close on the mason's palm, the chaplain's shoulder against the gate beside it, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunset in the gate tunnel of the first wall round the dungeon city. The great sluice gate has just been shut: a slab of stone and iron filling the arch, a row of thick stone wedges driven home along its foot. At the gate, in full profile facing right, the old gate-mason, a man of sixty-four with grey-white hair cropped very short, kneels with a mallet in his right hand, and his left palm is pressed flat on the last wedge; under his hand the seam between gate and wall is closing up as if the two were growing into one stone. Beside him, in full profile facing right, the half-orc chaplain with the drum, a big old half-orc with a small drum at his hip, has thrown his whole weight against the gate, both hands flat on it and his shoulder behind them, trying to push it open; the old scars that band his forearms have all gone white. The gate does not move. Between them and a step back, facing us, stands the grey-cloaked commander, short dark auburn hair heavily streaked with grey, a short grey-shot beard, a war hammer hanging in his right hand, his left hand raised flat to stop the men behind him. Through the last finger's width of the gate's edge shows a street covered ankle-deep in still black, and far away over the roofs, small, a pole on a hall roof flies a white cloth with a bird drawn on it. Torch sparks and stone dust drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第六拍和幕终（源稿第1112、1113行）：营长照封门令封了西口，佐西马把石楔一根一根敲回去，手掌按上去，闸跟墙连成了一块；穆罗转身去推闸，推不动，胳膊上的疤一道一道发白；佐西马隔着闸缝往西看，三里外旅印大厅的屋顶上竖着一根竿子，挑着一块白布，布上画着一只鸥。街上那一层黑照第1107行。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·白碑第七夜
nodes.name: 旅印齐亮
who: the half-orc chaplain with the drum
nodes.light: deep night, a field of small warm lights waking on distant rooftops, soft candle-gold on the singer, black figures at the gate with no light on them at all
nodes.camera: from the wall walk above the gate, behind the singer's shoulder, looking out over the black-flooded streets to the lit rooftops, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep night on the wall walk above a shut sluice gate of the first wall round the dungeon city. Beyond the wall the upper ring of the city lies flooded with a still black tide to the eaves, and people are crowded on the rooftops half a mile off. At this instant, on those rooftops, hundreds of small warm lights have come on together, one on the chest of each person there, like a field of lamps. Directly below the wall, in front of the gate, stand several companies of figures calling to be let in, and on them there is no light at all: they are black shapes with no faces. On the wall walk, in full profile facing right, stands the silver-braided candle-priestess, a woman of thirty-seven with long silver-white hair in one thick braid coiled at the back of her head, gentle golden eyes, a healer's white robe: her head is lifted and her mouth is open in song, her right hand is laid on the forearm of the man beside her, on a band of old scars gone white, and her left hand is pressed to her own chest. Beside her, facing us, the half-orc chaplain with the drum, a big old half-orc, has stopped with his right fist raised to strike the parapet and is staring at her, his left hand flat on his drum. Behind them, in full profile facing left, the grey-cloaked commander, grey-streaked auburn hair and a short beard, has lowered a war hammer halfway, both hands on its haft. Threads of song show in the air as five pale streams of light drawing together into one. Sparks and ash drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第五、六拍（源稿第1121、1122行）：塞拉芬一只手按在穆罗胳膊那一片发白的疤上，张口唱了白烛的守烛者，唱到第五句，门为回家的人开，五支调子合到了一处；屋顶上按过战印的人，胸口的旅印一齐亮了，隔着半里看得见一片灯，闸前叫门的那几支身上是黑的。灰斗篷的锤举到一半照第1120行。五支调子画成五道合拢的光，是我补的看得见的样子。闸前那些不画脸。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·白碑第七夜
nodes.name: 印与剑
who: the copper-haired empress with the old sword
nodes.light: a burning wooden lintel overhead dropping orange embers, a line of gold light opening along the ground to the right, a dull bronze-gold glow under the queen's hand on the left, black night and black tide all round
nodes.camera: low on the threshold itself, between the two of them, the gateway arch overhead and the split tide running away on the right, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the darkest hour of night on a road through a black tide, at a thing that has taken the shape of an old city's south gate: a stone gateway with a wooden lintel on fire, a row of small empty wicker baskets lined up inside the passage, and a little table with a dim seated figure behind it that has no face. One step outside the gateway, at its two ends, stand two women a gate's width apart, neither looking at the other. On the left the ash-silver-haired demon queen kneels on one knee in full profile facing right: long straight ash-silver hair, golden eyes, cold pale skin, a small red mark at her temple; her iron gauntlet lies on the ground beside her, and her bare right hand presses a heavy bronze-gold seal down on the stone threshold, her left hand on her knee. From under the seal the gateway is cracking upward through both jambs. On the right the copper-haired empress with the old sword stands in full profile facing right, her back to the queen: old-copper hair in a low braided bun with one loose strand; both hands on an old plain sword at the end of a flat, low sweep along the ground. From that stroke the black tide has split in a straight line away to the right, three miles of bare paving showing between two standing walls of darkness, a thread of gold light running down the middle to a far ring wall. The burning lintel is breaking up and coming down between them as layers of grey ash, like rain. Behind the queen, small, a woman with coral hair and red scales on her cheekbones backs away with a trident, unhurt. Ash and embers fall large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第四拍（源稿第1092行那一条）：同一刻两个人出了手，魔王褪下右手的铁手套，把山铜王印压在门槛上，门从门槛往上裂；凯撒拔了挽昼，贴着地往西一剑，潮从门槛一直裂到井口的第一道墙，三里长街露出了石地；烧着的门楣碎下来，落的是一层一层的灰，像一场雨。两个王隔着一个门洞宽，谁也没看谁；门洞里一溜篮子、小桌后头看不清脸的白骸照第一拍。篮子是空的，不画孩子。

nodes.line: 黑潮的年月·白碑第七夜
nodes.name: 鼓面当桌
who: the scaled sea-folk girl with the trident
the half-orc chaplain with the drum
nodes.light: clear morning light pouring through an open gate into a stone tunnel, steam from a big pot, warm on tired faces
nodes.camera: low at the level of the upturned drum and the bowls on it, the open gate bright behind the seated people, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: morning in the gate tunnel of the first wall round the dungeon city. The sluice gate stands wide open and daylight pours in; in the street beyond, the black tide has gone and the paving is wet and bare. In the tunnel a big iron pot hangs over a fire, and worn-out adventurers of many kinds sit along both walls with bowls, company next to company, more still walking in through the gate. In the foreground a small drum has been turned over to make a table, and bowls of soup stand on its skin. Sitting cross-legged beside it, facing us, is the half-orc chaplain with the drum, a big old half-orc with banded scars on his forearms: his right hand holds a ladle over a bowl, and his left hand steadies the drum. On the left, in full profile facing right, the scaled sea-folk girl with the trident, nineteen, fine scales along her cheek and neck, a three-pronged spear with a row of notches cut in its shaft laid across her knees, holds a bowl in both hands and pulls a face at the taste. On the right, facing us, sits a girl of sixteen in a red-trimmed jacket with a water yoke beside her, unhurt, both her hands wound tight in a coil of rope that she holds against her chest; she has not touched her bowl, and her eyes are on the open gate. On the wall walk above, small, a woman with a silver-white braid sits asleep against the parapet. Steam and dust in the gate light drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一拍（源稿第1138行）：天亮以后门洞里支起了锅，回来的队挨着坐下；苏珂嫌汤淡，穆罗把鼓翻过来当桌子，汐恩抱着博姆那根绳没有松手。苏珂三叉杆子上刻的道照第1109行。汐恩十六岁，没有立绘，照红闸那一队的见习写，不受伤。

nodes.name: 两根钟绳
nodes.light: cold first light of dawn from the right, low and gold on the east slope, the west slope still in blue shadow, black welling out of the fields on both sides
nodes.camera: on the wall top at the foot of the bell platform, close on the two buglers back to back, the two crowded slopes falling away left and right, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dawn on top of an immense white wall that runs from horizon to horizon across a plain. In the middle of the picture a stone bell platform stands on the wall top with one bell hanging in it, and two bell ropes hang down from the bell, one on the east side and one on the west. The whole east slope of the wall, on the right, is packed with human soldiers in blue-and-white, every one of them facing east, away from the wall; the whole west slope, on the left, is packed with horned demon-kin soldiers in black and bronze, every one facing west. Not one of them looks at the other side. Out in the wheat fields to the east, and from old tunnel mouths and graves to the west, black is welling up out of the ground in patch after patch as far as the eye can see. Against the stone of the bell platform two buglers sit back to back with the platform between them. On the right, in full profile facing right, the flaxen-haired bugler, twenty-two, short flaxen hair and a tight young face, holds a brass bugle with a dent in its bell across his knees in both hands. On the left, in full profile facing left, the fire-horn bugler, a woman of forty-three with two horns curving back from her temples, holds a long black horn-trumpet upright in her right hand with its butt on the stone, her left hand on her knee. Small on the next bell platform along the wall, a lamp is being lit. Wheat chaff and flecks of black drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一、二、五拍（源稿第1439、1440、1443行）：墙东的麦地、旧坟和旧地道口一处接一处往外冒黑；天亮的时候东坡站满了联邦的兵，脸朝东，西坡站满了黑耀的兵，脸朝西，中间隔着一道墙；每座钟台挂一口钟，钟绳东边一根，西边一根；两坡的号手背靠着同一座石台，东边是森克·霍恩，号口瘪了一块，西边是莎菲雅。钟台亮灯照幕终第1445行。

nodes.name: 铜灯未灭
nodes.light: black night on the wall top, one small old brass lamp burning on the stone at the foot of the bell platform, far orange flashes of cannon fire to the south
nodes.camera: at the level of the lamp on the stone, close, her hands coming down to it, the bell platform and the night above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the small hours of a black night on top of the long white wall, at the foot of a stone bell platform. On the paving lies an old brass hand lamp, tipped on its side, and its small flame is still burning. A few dark feathers are settling on the stone round it, and a strip of blue cloth lies beside it. Crouching over the lamp, facing us, is the snow-leopard-eared singer, twenty-four, snow-grey hair in one thick braid to the waist with a few dark round spots near its end, round spotted ears, a strip of blue cloth tied round her left arm: both her hands are reaching down, the right about to close on the lamp's handle, the left cupped to shield the flame. Her mouth is shut tight and her eyes are wet. Behind her, standing against the stone of the platform in full profile facing right, the fire-horn bugler, a woman of forty-three with two horns curving back from her temples, has lowered her long black horn-trumpet from her lips with her right hand and stretches her left hand out toward the girl, not yet touching her shoulder; she is staring up into the dark above the wall, where nothing can be seen. Far to the south along the wall, small, a salvo of cannon fire is landing half a mile from the next platform. Sparks and one drifting feather hang large and blurred in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕末两拍和幕终（源稿第1453到1455行）：值令官把纸条交给赫斯珀，嘴上添了一句错的；他又爬上墙头，从莎菲雅身边过去的时候说了一句我说错了，潮里飞的东西在钟台两边两道号之间追上了他；那盏旧铜灯掉在钟台脚下，没有灭，恩娜蹲下去把它捡了起来。赫斯珀倒下那一下不画，只画落下来的几根羽毛和蓝布条。

nodes.name: 双坡齐吹
who: the snow-leopard-eared singer with the lamp
nodes.light: three white searchlight beams crossing the wall top and pinning one figure, orange cannon bursts below on both sides, one small warm signal lamp held high in the centre, black night and black tide
nodes.camera: on the wall top at the foot of the bell platform, looking along the battlements north toward the pinned figure, the two buglers large in the foreground, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on top of the great white wall at a stone bell platform, with a black tide pressing against the wall on both sides at once. Along the wall top the soldiers of two armies stand in two ranks back to back, one rank facing out over the east side and the other facing out over the west side, shields up, the bell platform between them. In the foreground the two buglers stand shoulder to shoulder, both facing north along the wall with their backs to us turned a little apart: on the left the fire-horn bugler, black hair, horns curling back half a turn and ringed like tree rings, a long horn at her lips held in her right hand, a breath of fire coming out of its bell; on the right the flaxen-haired bugler, a young human soldier with short flaxen hair, a short brass bugle at his lips in his right hand, his left fist on his hip. On top of the bell platform between the ranks, facing us, stands the snow-leopard-eared singer with the lamp: round leopard ears, a long snow-grey braid, her right arm raised straight up holding a signal lamp, her left hand at her throat. Three searchlight beams from towers below cross the wall and meet on one figure standing far along the battlements to the north: a man-shaped shadow wrapped in black, two short horns bent forward, two points of brass at his chest, a horn half raised, with no face; the empty stretch of wall under his feet is cracking under cannon fire while he himself stands untouched. Sparks and stone dust fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第三、四拍（源稿第1424行那一条）：东坡的兵翻上墙头脸朝东，西坡的兵翻上来脸朝西，背靠着背，中间是钟台；恩娜举着赫斯珀那盏灯站在钟台顶上；那个人影举起了号，森克和莎菲雅一齐吹，一声走调的，一声带火的，把他那一声压在了底下；三道灯柱钉在他身上，他脚下那一截空了的墙替他挨着。两个号手原写纯背影，要露出吹号，写成背朝我们略分开，出图后看朝向对不对。墙头那个人影不画脸。

nodes.name: 七个名字
nodes.light: a clear cold autumn afternoon through the mouth of a gate tunnel, warm lamp glow on a stone wall, long light across a table
nodes.camera: low beside the table, the dented bugle close in the foreground, the wall of names and the hanging lamp behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a clear autumn afternoon in a stone room built into the side of a gate tunnel through the long white wall, its door open to the daylight. On the wall beside the door seven short lines of fine unreadable marks have been cut one under another, and above them, on a peg, hangs an old brass hand lamp, lit. Under the lamp, in full profile facing right, stands the snow-leopard-eared singer, twenty-four, a soft dark-blue kerchief tied over her head and knotted under her chin, covering the whole sides of her head and her cheeks down to the jaw, with two round spotted snow-leopard ears standing up through slits in its top; only her face shows in front, and one thick snow-grey braid hangs from under the kerchief at the back to her waist: she is on tiptoe with her right hand raised to the lamp, turning up its wick, and her left hand holds a small oil can; her lips are parted, singing under her breath. At a table in the foreground two people sit facing each other. On the left, in full profile facing right, the flaxen-haired bugler, twenty-two, in a blue-and-white soldier's coat, has turned a brass bugle over in both hands and is looking at the dent in its bell. On the right, in full profile facing left, the fire-horn bugler, a woman of forty-three with two horns curving back from her temples, in black and bronze, points at the dent with the forefinger of her right hand, her left hand round a cup; one corner of her mouth has lifted. At the back of the room, small, a sturdy dwarf woman with copper-orange braids coiled on her head measures lamp oil at a long bench. Dust motes in the door light hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第二、三拍（源稿第1469、1470行）：没回来的七个名字刻在外间门边的墙上，赫斯珀那盏灯挂在上头；霜降月停战纪念日，莎菲雅在葛丽桌边碰上森克，说896年西坡上那个号手是她背过墙头的，那支号也是她送回东坡的，森克把号翻过来看了看那块瘪。葛丽量油的长凳照第1471行。 11-25 第四手：头一稿恩娜雪豹耳以外颊边又露出一只人耳，写明两鬓厚发把头侧盖住重画。 11-25 第四手：第二稿恩娜照旧露出一只带耳环的人耳；第三稿给她系一块盖住头侧、下巴底下打结的深蓝头巾，豹耳从头巾顶上伸出。

nodes.name: 车顶挑翅
who: the veteran with the dancing sword
nodes.light: a train's lamps streaming gold along the track, a grey wing closing over the sky and swallowing the light, one thin bright line where a blade touches the wing's root
nodes.camera: low on the roof of the racing carriage behind her feet, looking up along her blade at the wing closing overhead, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night on a plain, a long train of lit carriages racing along a single rail that glows faintly. Over the train a wing is closing down out of the sky: one vast grey membrane, thin as a moth's, wide as a town, with no body and no face to be seen behind it, only the wing; wherever it covers them the train's lamps and the stars go out, and the front carriages are already running in pitch dark. On the roof of a carriage in the middle of the train stands the rose-gold-haired swordswoman, in full profile facing right, twenty-six, tall and slender, rose-gold hair streaming back in the wind, in a commander's light armour. Her feet are set wide on the roof. Her right arm is at full stretch above her head, and the point of a slim straight sword has gone up exactly into the seam where the wing joins its root, a thin bright line opening there; her left hand is out behind her for balance. Below her every window of the carriage is whole. On the step of the open carriage door, in full profile facing right, the veteran with the dancing sword, a weathered woman of thirty-eight, leans out holding the door frame with her left hand and a drawn sword low in her right, shouting up at her. At another window, small, a woman with a die hanging from one ear presses her face to the glass. Torn scraps of grey membrane and sparks from the rail fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第五拍（源稿第1765行）：下旬一日夏班下墙，她和西尔玛、泽娅坐星纱列车往花谷去；半路散场的一片翅追着车灯压下来，车在黑里走了十里，她上了车顶，剑刃只找翅根，车窗一扇也没破。散场的遮火照第1762行。翅根细的挑得着照第1763行。散场的只画一片翅，不画脸。

nodes.name: 灯下念誓
nodes.light: one great hanging lamp pouring gold straight down on her, the rest of the hall in rose and shadow, cold glints on three hundred crossbows, petals beginning to glow
nodes.camera: low among the flowers at the foot of the seven steps, looking up at her under the lamp, the ranks of crossbows behind her, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: near midnight in a great royal hall of rose-coloured stone. Before the throne rise seven broad steps, and at their foot lies a hill of cut flowers, one for each of the fallen. On the left of the hall sit hundreds of plain families, dyers and flower growers in their best; on the right the benches of the noble houses. The great doors stand open, and through them three hundred soldiers in a duke's livery have marched in and stand in ranks with crossbows wound and levelled at the throne and at a small reading table where a list lies under a stone. In the middle of the floor, under the one great hanging lamp, stands the rose-gold-haired swordswoman, facing us, twenty-six, tall and slender, rose-gold hair bound back, in a commander's dress uniform. She has drawn a plain officer's sword and holds it upright before her face in her right hand, the blade catching the lamp; her left hand is raised with three fingers up. Her lips are parted, speaking an oath. Round her feet the first petals are lifting off the hill of flowers by themselves and beginning to turn in the air. In front of the families on the left, in full profile facing right, the blue-black-haired duellist, thirty-six, lean and long-armed, has stepped out with his sword held crosswise in both hands, and behind him fifty hired swordsmen are turning their backs on the families to face the crossbows. On the throne, small, a king grips the arms of his seat. Petals and lamp motes drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第二、四、五拍（源稿第1773、1775、1776行）：公爵的三百个人一排一排走进来，弩上了弦，对着王座和读名的小桌；伊索尔德拔出腰上那把统领的佩剑，走到大灯底下念誓，今夜我取三样，甲扣，弓弦，握刀的那一只手的力气；昂利把剑横过来，带着那五十个人站到了家里人前头，脸朝外。七级台阶底下的花山照第1772行，名单拿石头压着照第1768行。

nodes.name: 花冠
who: the swordswoman of the falling flowers
nodes.light: rose-coloured light from millions of petals drifting upward into a black sky, beacon fires coming back one by one along the wall, the blue-black underside of a vast wing above
nodes.camera: low on the wall walk behind the two women, looking up along the sword at the petals and the wing, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the hours before dawn on top of the great white wall in early winter. Over twenty miles of wall hangs the underside of one immense dark wing, with no body and no face to be seen, blotting out seven beacon platforms; where it covers the wall no fire burns and searchlight beams break off short. At a battlement in the foreground the swordswoman of the falling flowers stands on the parapet in full profile facing right, poised on the ball of one foot in a dancer's step: her right hand holds a slim sword raised high, its tip having just flicked upward through an armful of cut flowers, her left arm stretched behind for balance. From that flick, rose petals are streaming up into the sky by the million instead of falling, and they are settling in a ring round the nearest beacon platform like a wreath; wherever the petals reach, the wing is coming away from the sky at its roots in long severed strips, and under it the beacon fires are showing again, one platform after another into the distance, the night sky turning rose. Beside her on the wall walk, facing us, the wounded woman beating time sits against the parapet, her left arm bound in a blood-soaked bandage and held to her chest, her right hand raised mid-clap against her thigh, her chin up, her mouth set in a hard grin. Along the wall behind them soldiers of several liveries clap the same beat with their free hands, and gunners swing their cannon toward the uncovered sky. Petals fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第四、六拍（源稿第1747行那一条）：伊索尔德上了垛口，剑尖从车上带来的花里一挑，花瓣往天上落，墙那头的夜空一片一片亮成蔷薇色，花到哪里，哪里的翅就从根上断开，号台的火一座一座露出来；花瓣绕着号台落成一圈，像一顶花冠。西尔玛拿没伤的那只手拍拍子、血顺着袖口滴照第三、五拍。散场的只画成一道翅，不画脸。

nodes.name: 别一朵花
nodes.light: a clear cold sunrise along the wall top, gold on stone and on a ring of flowers, long blue shadows, white breath in the air
nodes.camera: on the wall walk beside the battlement, close on her hands at her collar, the ring of flowers on the stone and the relieved guard beyond, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise on top of the long white wall, at a signal platform whose fire is burning again and whose searchlights are whole. All round the battlement of the platform, laid on the stone in one unbroken ring, lies a garland of fresh flowers and petals, as if a wreath had been set on the wall itself. Fresh soldiers in winter cloaks are marching up the stair to take over the watch, and tired ones are filing down past them, every one alive. In the foreground, facing us, stands the rose-gold-haired swordswoman, twenty-six, tall and slender, rose-gold hair loose on her shoulders, in a plain soldier's coat with her sword belted on. With her right hand she is pinning one small flower to the breast of her coat, her left hand holding the cloth flat; her head is bent to watch her fingers, and she is smiling a very little. Behind her, small, three soldiers of the night watch stand at the battlement pointing from the ring of flowers to her and back, one of them laughing. A cart piled with a square crystal casket waits at the foot of the stair, and beside it an old nobleman in a soldier's plain cloak has taken up a spear at the wall. Petals and frost motes drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一、二、五拍（源稿第1791、1792、1795行）：天亮以后，第三座号台的兵指着垛口上那一圈花叫她花冠剑首；冬班接了墙，公爵自己留在第三座号台；冬班接墙的头一天线上没有死人，伊索尔德在胸前别了一朵花。魔晶匣照二幕幕终第1778行。

nodes.name: 九十九座
nodes.light: deep blue night in a bare stone room, and on the floor a sheet of water full of tiny golden city lights, layer under layer, lighting his face from below
nodes.camera: low at the level of the water, close on his counting hand, the layered cities running away under the surface, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the small hours of the night in a bare round room high in a tower by a lake; a hanging lamp burns upside down from the ceiling, and the stone floor is covered by a finger's depth of perfectly still water. In that water there is no reflection of the room. Instead it holds the image of a lake city seen from above, bridges, towers, quays and all their night lights; and the image has come apart into copies of itself, one under another and one beside another, ninety-nine cities laid like sheets of glass, each a little different from the next, filling the whole floor to the walls. At the edge of the water kneels the lake-country mage, in full profile facing right: a man of thirty with long deep blue hair, a fine mist clinging to his hair and to his plain robe, deep green eyes. He is bent low over the water. His right hand is stretched out with the forefinger touching the surface above one of the cities, counting, a small ring spreading from the touch; his left hand is braced on the wet stone, and an open notebook lies by his knee with a pencil across it. His lips are moving. In the nearest city under his finger a stone bridge is missing that stands in the city beside it. Through the one narrow window, small, the real city sleeps along the lake shore. Mist and points of reflected light drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一到三拍（源稿第2027到2029行）：后半夜，水房地上那层水里，银湖城的倒影分开了，一座接一座，一层叠一层，铺满了一屋子的地；他跪在水边一座一座地数，数到九十九座；对出四件小事，老堤上的石桥没有了是其中一件。倒悬的灯照第2030行。

nodes.name: 钟房对图
who: the ginger-curled dyer with the red headband
nodes.light: late afternoon light through the open arches of a bell room, gold on paper and bronze, the lake bright far below
nodes.camera: at the height of the table, close on the open book of bell scores and the one blank page, the three faces round it, the great bell above, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late afternoon in the bell room at the top of a tide tower beside a great lake, open arches on every side, one big bronze bell hanging overhead. A rough table stands under the bell, covered with three large charts of the lake weighted down with stones, and on a board among them lie strips of dried fish. Three people are bent over the table. In the middle, facing us, the lake-country mage, thirty-three, long deep blue hair with a fine mist clinging to it, deep green eyes, holds two of the charts edge to edge with both hands, matching their shorelines. On the left, in full profile facing right, the ginger-curled dyer with the red headband, a young woman with short ragged ginger curls tied back with a strip of red cloth, chews a strip of dried fish held in her left hand and jabs at a spot on the chart with her right forefinger, scowling at him. On the right, in full profile facing left, the white-haired old tide-keeper, a brisk woman of seventy-eight with very short stiff white hair, has opened a thick old book of bell scores with both hands and holds it toward them: every page is ruled and filled with rows of small marks, except the page she is showing, where one whole night has been left blank. Her eyes are narrowed at the blank. Through the arches behind them, small, the lake city lies along the shore with a long stone bridge, and far out a marsh of a thousand pools shines. Dust motes and a gull's feather drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第四拍（源稿第2039行）：这三年他常跟克洛蒂尔德、妮侬在潮汐塔的钟房里就着干鱼对图；克洛蒂尔德翻出919年的钟谱，北岸涨湖那一夜是空的，潮没有到涨的日子。三张图对上照第2041行。钟谱写成认不出的细痕。

nodes.name: 立起的湖
nodes.light: silver mirror-fog full of hanging strings of lamps, the grey first light before dawn, a standing wall of lake water shining like glass and holding a picture inside it
nodes.camera: low on the drained lake bed at the foot of the water wall, looking up it past the mage's raised arms, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the last dark before dawn in a country of a thousand small lakes and reed dykes, wrapped in a silver mirror-fog. In the fog above the ponds hang ninety-nine copies of the same lamplit lake city, one stacked above another into the sky, strings of lamps hanging upside down, and in the street of each one stands the same small man in a mage's coat. In the foreground a mile of pond has just been emptied: the bed is bare mud with fish flopping in it, and all its water has been pulled upright into one wall that stands from one end of an old dyke to the other, taller than a tower, clear as glass. Inside the wall, like a picture in a mirror, a scene shows: a man with an unlit little crystal lamp hanging from his ear prising up a sealing stone with an iron bar. Before the wall, on the mud, stands the lake-country mage in full profile facing right, both arms thrown straight up with fingers spread, holding the water; he has exactly two arms and two hands, and the wall of water does not mirror him: no second arm, no extra hand and no reflection of him shows in it, his coat soaked to the thighs, his face set. A black tide has struck the far side of the wall and is recoiling, and the ninety-nine hanging cities are shattering like glass, all at once. On the dyke behind him, in full profile facing right, the woman tying red cloth kneels knotting a strip of red cloth to a reed stem with both hands, a line of such red strips marking a path back through the fog, her mouth open, scolding. In a gap of the dyke a ferryman poles an empty flat boat. Shards of mirror-fog and drops of water fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第五、六拍（源稿第2013行那一条）：卢米安把千湖的塘水从地上拽了起来，几里长的塘一下子见了底，鱼在泥里跳，水立成一道从老堤这一头排到那一头的墙；水墙上照出了卢卡迪，也照出了919年的那一夜，撬封石的人耳上挂着一盏不点的小晶灯；九十九座城一齐碎了，潮撞在墙上，退了一截。妮侬把红布一截一截系在苇子上、若斯撑着空船横在缺口照第四拍。

nodes.name: 石阶七名
who: the ginger-curled dyer with the red headband
nodes.light: blue dusk over still water, one warm lamp held close over the wet stone, its light on a chisel and on two faces
nodes.camera: low on the steps at the level of the chisel, close on the seventh line of marks, the lamp and her hand above, the lake behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk at a stone quay on the south shore of a great lake, a flight of worn steps going down into the water. Out on the lake, small, a ferry is moored across a gap where a stone bridge used to stand on an old levee, and beyond it the water lies wide where a marsh of a thousand pools was. On one of the steps, just above the waterline, kneels the lake-country mage, in full profile facing right: thirty-three, long deep blue hair tied back, a fine mist on it, deep green eyes, sleeves rolled. In his left hand he holds a small chisel against the stone and in his right a mallet, lifted for the next stroke. Cut into the step in front of him are six short lines of fine marks, and he is halfway through a seventh. Beside him, facing us, crouches the ginger-curled dyer with the red headband, short ragged ginger curls tied back with a strip of red cloth: with her right hand she holds a lamp low over the stone so that he can see, and her left hand rests on his shoulder. Her mouth is open, telling him something sharply, and her eyes are kind. Tied to the mooring post at the top of the steps, a strip of red cloth stirs in the wind, and up the quay, small, a cook pot steams outside a fisherman's door. Lamp motes and lake mist drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第四拍（源稿第2059行）：下旬十日，他在南岸码头往湖里去的石阶上刻了七个名字，妮侬在旁边举着灯，刻完了喊他去喝鱼汤，先报日子，再骂他慢。若斯的渡船拴在缺口上、老堤没有再造桥照第2060行。名字写成认不出的细痕。

nodes.name: 满港北旗
who: the wind-rider with the long blade
nodes.light: a hard bright winter sunrise over a city on a mountain ridge, gold on sails and frost, deep blue sky to the north, breath and steam white
nodes.camera: from just above the mooring racks, close behind the rider on the white wyvern, the whole fleet lifting off below and behind him, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise in early winter over a sky harbour built on a mountain ridge, a city of towers and wind platforms hung with bells, every bell swinging. From long timber mooring racks thirty-seven airships of every size and age are casting off one after another, patched sails, old cargo hulls, two wrecks sewn together out of used canvas, and from the mast of every one flies the same small flag pointing north. In front of them all, in the foreground, flies a storm wyvern with frost-white scales, lean and ragged, both its eyes clouded over white and blind, a strip of cloth tied to its halter. On its back, in full profile facing right, sits the wind-rider with the long blade, a man of thirty with blue-grey hair tied at the nape, pale grey eyes, a long curved blade sheathed across his back: his left hand holds the halter rein and his right hand is laid flat on the wyvern's neck, guiding it by touch. Just behind and below, at the bow of the oldest cargo ship, facing us, stands the azure-scaled dragonborn warden, a tall woman with azure-silver scales along her jaw, small horns and folded wings, both hands on the bow rail, her eyes on the north. Beside the slowest ship at the rear, small, the wheat-haired eagle knight rides a giant eagle close along its hull. On the racks people wave and a wolf-eared woman at a ship's wheel shouts an order. Frost crystals and scraps of old sailcloth fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终（源稿第2300行）：上旬六日天亮，三十七艘一艘接一艘离了泊架，苍风骑着霜嗝飞在最前头，索尔维站在伦卡那一艘的船头，罗阿尔的巨鹰贴着最慢的那一艘飞，满城的铃一齐响了。往北的旗、拿旧帆缝的旧壳子照第2296、2297行。霜嗝霜白的鳞、两只眼睛蒙着一层白照第2298行，没有参考图，照文字写。

nodes.name: 空喉
who: the wind-rider with the long blade
nodes.light: a grey snow sky with a black hole torn in it, seven colours flaring along a far snow ridge on the left, hard white snow light below
nodes.camera: low in the snow at the foot of the last pole, looking up past her raised hand at the hole in the cloud and the ships being dragged toward it, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a winter afternoon on a snow plain under high mountains, a village of low stone houses half buried, a line of tall poles running away across the snow, an old shed dragon scale hanging at the top of each. The sky above the village has been punched in: one whole cloud has collapsed inward into a round black hole, its rim curled like the lips of an enormous open mouth, with no eyes and no face, only the mouth, and every wind for miles is pouring into it. Two half-loaded airships have been sucked up off the ground with their gangplanks still down and hang tilted in the air, people clinging to the rails, and the old dragon scales hung on the pole heads, each a single shield-sized reptile scale, are tearing off one by one and flying upward. Far to the left, along a snow ridge, seven colours are flaring, and the whole sheet of cloud for hundreds of miles is being pressed lower from that side. In the foreground, at the last pole of the line, stands the azure-scaled dragonborn warden, facing us, a tall woman with azure-silver scales along her jaw, small horns and wings held tight against the wind: her right hand has just pulled the old scale off this pole and holds it against her chest, and her left arm is flung out pointing back at the ships, her mouth wide, shouting an order to board. Beside her, in full profile facing left, the wind-rider with the long blade, blue-grey hair whipping, has drawn his long curved blade and holds it low in both hands, his body leaning into the wind toward the hole. Snow and torn scales streak large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第五到七拍（源稿第2308到2310行）：中旬二日，村子上头的天响了一声，一块云塌进去，四下里的风往那一块灌，装了一半的两艘船叫它吸得离了地，杆头的旧鳞一片一片扯上天；北边的雪脊上亮了七种颜色，一声龙吼横着过来；索尔维说天上那个只有一张嘴，拔下那根杆子上的旧鳞。空喉只画云里一张嘴，没有脸；七色是远处的龙君，不画龙。｜11-25 第三手（出图以前）：“old scales”怕叫画成秤，写明是挂在杆头的龙鳞。

nodes.name: 裁开的云
who: the wind-rider with the long blade
nodes.light: a mile-long slash of clear starlit night opening through storm cloud, snow blown up into two white walls on either side of it catching cold starlight, ship lanterns small and warm behind
nodes.camera: from the bow of the leading airship, looking up the ridge along the line of the cut, the rider at its far end, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk turned to night high above a snow mountain ridge. A fleet of thirty-seven sky ships with patched sails rides the wind in a long line, each with an old dragon scale hung at its bow under a lantern. Over the crest of the ridge the sky itself has opened into a vast empty throat: a round gulf of nothing where the stars have been wiped out, the snow of both slopes streaming upward into it, and at its rim the dim outline of half a dragon's face made of emptiness, with no eyes. Straight into that throat flies a small frost-grey wyvern with an old scar at the root of one wing, its jaws open in a cry, and on its back rides the wind-rider with the long blade, seen directly from behind: a scarf whipping from his neck, both hands on a long curved sabre at the end of one stroke carried from far left to far right. Along the line of that stroke the throat has been split in two halves that are peeling apart, and through the storm cloud beyond it runs a clean slash a mile long; the wind of the cut has thrown the mountain's snow up into two white walls, and between them the night sky is clear and full of stars. The first sky ship is already sliding into the opening, and on its deck, small, a dragonborn child points straight up. A giant eagle with a rider wheels beside the fleet. Snow and torn cloud fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第七拍（源稿第2280行那一条）：霜嗝迎着那张口冲过去，叫了一声，那半张龙脸顿住了，苍风的刀就落在这一顿里，从这一头劈到那一头，把那一副喉劈成了两半，乱流里开出一道一里来长的口子，漫山的雪叫刀风扬到两侧，一里长的雪墙中间露出了清透的夜空；三十七艘从口子里滑过了山脊，龙裔孩子指着头顶。空喉写成一口空，半张没有眼睛的龙脸的轮廓。船头挂的旧鳞照第三拍。

nodes.name: 风台布带
nodes.light: a pale cold dawn after a night of wind, thin fresh snow in the air, the first gold on the highest roof, the harbour below in blue shadow
nodes.camera: from above the finial on the highest wind platform, close on his hands tying the strip, the city and the mooring racks far below, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a pale dawn after a night of wind, fine new snow drifting down over a sky harbour on a mountain ridge. On the very top of the highest wind platform of a royal palace, on a narrow cap of stone round an iron finial, crouches the wind-rider, facing us: a man of thirty with blue-grey hair tied at the nape, pale grey eyes rimmed red, his coat torn, no blade in his hands. With both hands he is tying a short worn strip of cloth to the iron finial, his right hand drawing the knot tight and his left holding the end; the strip is already streaming out in the wind. His jaw is set and he does not look down. Far below him the mooring racks of the harbour are crowded with thirty-seven battered airships made fast, people still being helped down their gangplanks into the mouths of caves under the palace. On the outermost rack, small, a long white shape lies covered with a sail, and a young knight stands beside it with his head bowed and a giant eagle at his shoulder. Over the ridge to the north, where a hole stood in the sky, there is only a thinning patch of cloud letting down snow. Snowflakes and loose threads of cloth drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一、三拍（源稿第2326、2328行）：空喉合不上了，在山脊顶上漏了一夜的风，天亮散成了一场雪；霜嗝天亮以前死在泊架上，苍风把它笼头上那一截布带解下来，爬到王宫最高那一座风台的顶上系住，说他在这里停过。霜嗝画成泊架上盖着帆的一道白，不画死相。王宫底下的石窟照第2329行。

nodes.name: 起闸
who: the old fire-horn with cracked horns
the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns
nodes.light: the first gold light of an early-spring dawn across the well mouth, bright on a rising gate and on hundreds of small brass seals, blue shadow down the shaft
nodes.camera: from two steps down the long stair, looking up through the opening gate at the three of them and the column behind, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: daybreak at the head of the long stair that winds down the inside of the great well. A heavy sluice gate of iron and stone that has closed the stair for more than a hundred years is going up. In full profile facing right, the old fire-horn with cracked horns, a huge demon-kin man with grey hair and two short straight horns cracked at the tips, hauls the gate chain down hand over hand with both fists, and the gate is lifting above his head. Through the opening, first of all, steps the pale-gold-haired guild master, a woman with short tousled pale gold hair, a chalk-line box at her belt: she is seen directly from behind, already on the first stair, her right hand on the shaft wall and her left arm raised to wave the others on. Behind the old fire-horn, facing us, stands the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns, red hair and two straight horns, a bundle of iron camp stakes on her right shoulder held with her right hand, a mallet in her left. Behind them the whole square at the well mouth is filled with a column of thirteen hundred adventurers of every people, a small brass travel seal glinting on every chest. At a table by the column, small, an old rabbit-eared woman presses a child's worn glove down beside a name on a long list while a clerk writes. Dust and chain rust drift large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一到四拍（源稿第2563到2566行）：蕾雅把单子念了一遍，往下打，一层一层接回来；报名桌前有人压下一只手套，灰径家的老妇人为7年没上来的斯基普·灰径压下一只；塔隆听到一千三百零四这个数，点了一下头，他身后是法丽达·黑燧，红头发，两只直角；上旬四日天亮，塔隆拉起闸，蕾雅头一个下了长阶。

nodes.name: 桩外酒棚
who: the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns
nodes.light: one warm tavern lamp glowing in a gorge of pale bone, cold lantern light on a ring of iron stakes, blackness underneath the shed
nodes.camera: low inside the ring of stakes behind the two women, looking out at the lit shed and down at the black shape it stands on, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night deep underground in a gorge whose walls are fused bone, at a half-crushed outpost on a natural bridge of bone, ringed by iron stakes with lanterns on them. Just outside the ring of stakes stands a wine shed that was not there an hour ago: planks, casks, a warm lamp, a counter, and behind the counter a broad man with wolf ears, his face lost in the shadow under the lamp, holding out a full cup. A score of tired fighters have stepped over the line of stakes toward it, cups already in their hands. Under the shed the truth shows: it stands on the split tip of a single black finger thicker than a tower that rises out of the depth of the gorge, with no hand and no face to be seen, and the drinkers nearest the counter are beginning to slide toward the split. The bone walls on both sides are bending inward like a throat closing. In the foreground, inside the ring, in full profile facing right, the frost-blue wolf-eared woman, forty-three, long frost-blue hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, wolf ears laid flat, has stopped one step short of the line: her right hand is stretched toward the man at the counter and her left hand grips the top of a stake so hard that the knuckles are white. Beside her, in full profile facing right, the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns swings a mallet down with both hands onto the head of an iron stake at the very edge of the line, her teeth bared. Sparks and bone dust fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕末两拍（源稿第2582、2583行）：花信月下旬九日夜里，前哨的桩圈外头亮起一座酒棚，跟第三十层塌掉的那座一模一样，柜台后头一个狼耳男人叫着苒卡父亲的名字，守前哨外环的二十来个人已经端着杯子；酒棚一塌，底下是一根比第二十层那截粗一倍的指头，指尖裂着口子，棚里的人正往口子里滑，整条骨谷像一条喉咙那样往里收。法丽达钉桩照第2570行。那一位只画一根指头，柜台后头那张脸收在暗处。

nodes.name: 无闩门前
who: the old fire-horn with cracked horns
nodes.light: the dark red fire in the cracks of his two horns, the only warm light, against a towering gate of pale stone and the grey shimmer of a narrow place where space itself folds; a faint black rain inside the gate
nodes.camera: from the third step below him, looking up the last stairs at him and the gate rising out of frame, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the deepest place men have reached under the earth: a narrow pass where the two sides of space draw together to a dozen stone steps, and at the top of the steps a gate of pale stone taller than a city gate, standing open, with no bolt and no bar. Inside the gate hangs a thin black rain. On the threshold lies the stump of an enormous severed hand, wider than the gate, its fingers gone, with no face and no eye anywhere on it, dissolving into black water that seeps into the cracks of the stone. On the top step, in front of the gate and facing it with his back to us, stands the old fire-horn with cracked horns: broad and worn, brick-red hair, two straight black-tipped horns whose cracks burn with a steady dark red fire. His left hand is laid flat on the stone of the gate post, feeling its grain; his right hand holds a long quarry hammer drawn back level with his shoulder, about to strike one chosen spot. A fine crack has already begun at that spot and is running up the gate. A waterskin lies empty on the step beside his boot. Three steps below him, turned to look back up at him and facing us, stands the map-maker, messy dark hair shot with silver, a satchel of rolled maps on his back; in his right hand he holds a small brass seal on a cord that has just been given to him, his left hand on the wall, his face stricken. Far below them the pass falls away into a grey shimmer where squares of broken ground hang in the air, joined by a single rope. Motes of red fire and black drops drift large and blurred across the near corners.

who: the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns
nodes.light: late autumn daylight through tall hall windows, warm on a wall of small hanging keepsakes, the crowd in soft shadow
nodes.camera: from among the seated crowd, looking up at the two who have stood and past them at the reader and the board, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a late-autumn day in the great seal hall of the adventurers' guild, packed with people sitting on benches and on the floor. One whole wall is a board studded with hundreds of nails, and on every nail hangs a small brass travel seal or some keepsake: a glove, a spoon, a child's shoe, a ribbon of cloth. In front of the board, facing us, stands the pale-gold-haired guild master, short tousled pale gold hair, reading aloud from a thick book held open in both hands. In the crowd two people have risen to their feet. In the middle, in full profile facing right, stands the red-haired fire-horn woman with straight horns, red hair, two straight horns, in a clean plain coat: her right hand is closed round a small brass seal on a cord held against her chest, her left hand hangs at her side, and her chin is up. On the left, facing us, the frost-blue wolf-eared woman, long frost-blue hair in one thick braid over her left shoulder, has both arms round an old wolf-eared man of seventy-seven with white hair and a white beard, wearing a knitted wool cap pulled down over both sides of his head to the jaw, his two grey wolf ears standing up through holes in the cap and no other ears anywhere, holding him upright on his feet; his right hand is lifted a little, as if answering to his name, and he is weeping and smiling. Everyone else sits and looks up at them. Through the open doors at the back, small, long tables are being laid in the square and families are carrying out covered dishes, an old rabbit-eared woman with a tray of baked apples among them. Dust motes in the window light hang large and soft in the near corners.
